newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech financial share gains lift PSE to 1996 high.
newsitem.headline: Czech financial share gains lift PSE to 1996 high.

text.p: Czech financial stocks posted strong gains to end the week on the Prague Stock Exchange to push the bourse to another 1996 high.
Banks Komercni Banka, Ceska Sporitelna, and Zivnostenska Banka all gained ground to push the PX50 index up 2.5 points to this year's high of 577.4.
Overall, advancers led decliners by 189 to 153 with 79 issues unchanged. Total volume was lighter with 660,306 shares changing hands on turnover of 554.5 million crowns.
For Komercni shares, it was the end of a successful week which saw the issue climb some 250 crowns above last Friday's open to close at 2,500.

"We're seeing decent volumes of Komercni shares trading, and I expect it to continue with the Czech Republic's inclusion into the Morgan Stanley emerging market index which will attract many portfolio investors," said one broker.
On the broader market, glass fibre maker Vertex jumped 276 crowns to 5,797.
For Vertex, it was the third gain of 200 crowns or more this week, after experiencing a major correction over the past two weeks.
Vertex has gained some 5,000 crowns in July, the result of a takeover battle between two investment funds, to peak at 7,204 before the correction which saw it fall below 5,000.
